breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the arithmetic-mean area of 325 mm^2 for deformation calculations,' directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires using the actual varying area A(x) in the integral without any mean-area substitution. The agent failed to remove this incorrect approximation and even calculated the specific mean value (325 mm²), making the error more concrete rather than correcting it.
